name: Yathsel
summary: Yathsel is a Wild West dice roguelite: play crooked Yahtzee-style hands, sneak loaded artifact dice from the smuggler under the table, and cheat your way past gunslinging rivals in a solo campaign, quick duels, and online saloons with ranked 1v1 for up to 8 players.
